newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: YIELDS STEADY TO HIGHER ON LATEST SAUDI T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: YIELDS STEADY TO HIGHER ON LATEST SAUDI T-BILLS.

text.p: Yields were steady to higher at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills.
Bankers said the yield on 28-day bills was flat at 5.7384 percent and the rate on 91-day bills was steady at 5.7936.
The yield on 182-day paper rose to 5.8879 from 5.8551 and the rate on 364-day bills climbed to 6.0860 percent from 6.0425.
The bills were priced at 99.55566, 98.55664, 97.10938 and 94.20313 respectively.
One-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent, three months were at 5-15/16, 13/16, six months were at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one year funds were at 6-1/4, 1/8.
